newsitem.title: USA: Jewish leader disputes Swiss claim on Nazi profits.
newsitem.headline: Jewish leader disputes Swiss claim on Nazi profits.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank made a profit of more than $3 billion in dealings in looted Nazi gold rather than $4.8 million as a top Swiss bank official claimed last week, a Jewish leader charged on Monday.

World Jewish Congress Vice President Kalman Sultanik, whose organisation has been in a fight with Switzerland over its wartime banking role, said he was astounded by a claim by the Swiss National Bank that it made a profit of around 20 million Swiss francs ($4.8 million) in gold transactions with the German Reichsbank from 1939 to 1945.

"The Swiss neglected to include capital gains in their estimate. The gold they are talking about was looted by the Nazis from throughout Europe and they were able to keep about $240 million which is worth about $3 billion today," Sultanik said.
After the war, the Swiss agreed to give the United States, Britain and France $60 million to be returned to the countries from which the gold was looted.

Swiss National Bank board member Jean-Pierre Roth said on Friday that this was because "the allies refused to accept that the National Bank had known nothing of the criminal origin of part of the gold delivered by the Reichsbank."

While Roth insisted the Swiss paid the equivalent of 1.6 percent of Switzerland's national income, Sultanik said the U.S. National Archives have shown that they really received $300 million worth of gold from the Germans, the vast majority of which represented looted gold.
